schema:name: Mittlefehldt (2024) GCA; Lee (Rice University) Excel data reduction spreadsheet
schema:description: laSficpmsTAPP instance derived from Mittlefehldt 2024 Appendix A Pallasite olivine Spot analysis ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Johnson Space Center (publication column of LA-SF-ICP-MS_TAPP_v16.xlsx).

schema:location.schema:name: ICP-MS Laboratory, NASA Johnson Space Center, Houston TX, USA

ada:sampleFormAnalyticalSubstrateDefault: In situ — polished grain mount (olivine grain fragments)
ada:samplePreparationMethodDefault: Olivine grain fragments repeatedly washed in dilute HCl and triply distilled H₂O, hand-picked, polished grain mounts
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g measured as calibration standards; Marjalahti as in-session control
ada:internalStandardApproach: Single element from EPMA: ²⁵Mg; the EMPA data used as the standardizing values
ada:internalStandardElement: ²⁵Mg (indexing element; Mg concentration from EMPA)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: External calibration using BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, BIR-1g; ²⁵Mg IS from EPMA corrects for ablation yield variation; no explicit downhole fractionation correction described
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni, Zn count rates (indicating inclusions or cracks) excluded from integration; manual inspection
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Gas blank measured before each analysis (laser shutter closed); time steps with background-level signals excluded during data reduction
ada:interferenceCorrectionMethod: Medium mass resolution (M/ΔM ≈ 4000) separates many polyatomic interferences from analyte peaks (e.g., resolves ⁵⁴Fe⁺ from ⁵⁴Cr⁺)
ada:primaryCalibrationStandardNameDefaul: USGS standard glasses BCR-2g, BHVO-2g, and BIR-1g; preferred values from GeoReM website
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialsDefault: BCR-2G, BHVO-2G, BIR-1G processed as unknowns alongside samples (same standards as calibration — in-session validation)
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: Sc: good agreement with Davis (1977) INAA values within measurement scatter; overall accuracy verified by comparison with literature INAA and SIMS data; Marjalahti used as in-session control (Mn deviation from reference value noted as 4.2% above Ryder 1984)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Time steps with enhanced P, Ca, Co, Ni, Zn excluded (inclusions and heterogeneities); Grubb's test applied to EPMA data for outlier detection

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Single spot per location (75 µm circular)
